name: Grid Checker
description: 3×3 grid alternates in a checkerboard pattern — odd and even positions pulse out of phase

variations.name: default
variations.description: 5 dots on even positions and 4 dots on odd positions pulse half a cycle apart, creating a flickering checkerboard

props.name: dotSize
